question: What monetary limit applies to each duty and account, and how many independent approvals does each class of transaction need?
decision: Per-organization, constitution-approved financial thresholds and account/duty limits control; the figures under $500 one approver, $500+ two, $10,000+ board approval are demonstration defaults ONLY until each union formally adopts or changes them. Maker cannot approve their own transaction. No payment authorization is activated merely by staging defaults.
originalProposedDecision: Per org. Platform default: one approval under $500, two independent approvals at $500 or more, board approval at $10,000 or more.
independentApprovalScope: decision wording / platform baseline only; NOT independent security or operational testing
approvedByRole: Founder & Product Owner, Nzila OS (Nzila Ventures) — platform/product only; contracting legal name unverified
